lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A highly structured grid of high-luminance circular nodes posterior to the gill slits, transitioning from dense vertical columns to a more widely spaced, staggered arrangement toward the mid-flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Visible vertical bands of slightly elevated pixel intensity that cross horizontal rows of high-luminance spots, creating a distinct lattice-like grid across the central lateral surface.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three prominent horizontal linear features on the upper flank exhibiting a sharp vertical luminance gradient, with high-intensity peaks on the superior margins and well-defined shadow troughs on the inferior margins.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Sparse distribution of high-luminance blobs within the macro-mask of the first dorsal fin, with a higher concentration observed near the basal attachment and fewer, isolated spots toward the apex.

other_distinctive_markers: A high-density cluster of small, high-intensity circular blobs on the dorsal surface of the primary pectoral fin, contrasting with the larger and more widely spaced spots on the main torso.
